room: Stylised 3D still in exactly the designer art-toy style of the reference pictures (vinyl-and-felt figures, matte skin, hair as one solid sculpted shape, real fabric clothes with a coarse soft weave), set INDOORS, in Timo's small hand-built model room in the same sunny model town. Evening: low golden sunset light pours in through one window on the LEFT and lies warm on the wall, with long soft violet shadows. In this room Timo wears NO backpack. The characters are exactly those of the reference pictures, unchanged: TIMO (tall and thin, black flat-top, dark brown skin, teal track jacket with a cream sleeve stripe, navy trousers, tiny teal backpack, big yellow watch on his left wrist, teal-and-coral scarf knotted short at the throat), LUNA (short, coral bob with a full fringe, freckles, coral football shirt with a cream collar, light-blue denim shorts, cream socks, chunky cream trainers, her own scarf, plain teal in two soft teal tones with no coral on it, hanging long), BIG YELLOW (the giant sunflower-yellow hard-shell suitcase with dark-violet wheels and one short fixed handle; standing upright its flat top reaches Luna's chest) and the fat ginger CAT with the cream belly and half-closed eyes. Vertical 9:16 film frame, eye-level camera, 28mm lens, soft background. No letters, numbers, words, signs, logos or clock faces anywhere: every paper is blank or carries only a simple little drawing.
wall: The whole back wall is covered with Timo's trip plan: dozens of paper squares and blank sticky notes in yellow, coral and mint, a few little drawn pictures (a football, an aeroplane, a bed, a train), all joined by red strings between pins, with a big paper cut-out of a round stadium in the middle. There is no writing on any of it.
